caption:
Shaadi + horror = Bhoot Ki Baraat 👻🪘

Socha AI ko thoda filmy challenge dete hain: 2 bilkul alag genres milao aur dekho kaisi movie nikalti hai. Dulha toh aa gaya... par baraati 100 saal purane hain. Aur dulhan? Ghost hunter. 😂

Is idea ko maine ek chhote Movie Mashup game mein badla. Genre choose karo → button dabao → fictional movie ka plot aur twist dekho. Demo mein 3 preset examples hain; game live AI se stories generate nahi karta.

Khud try karna hai? Ye prompt copy karke ChatGPT ya apne AI coding tool mein daalo 👇

“Build a mobile-friendly Movie Mashup game using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Let me choose between three pairs: Shaadi × Horror, Romance × Sci-fi, and Mystery × Comedy. When I tap a button, show an original fictional movie title, one-line plot and funny twist from local sample data. Add a Try Another button. Make it readable on a phone. Don't use API keys, real movie posters, actor likenesses or copyrighted characters. Tell me how to run it locally.”

Fictional poster art is AI-generated. Working starter: github.com/pankajgupta0299/buildwithpankaj-renderer/tree/main/reel08

Ab tum batao: next mashup Cricket × Mystery ya Office × Sci-fi? 👇

#BuildWithPankaj #BuildWithAI #MovieMashup #CreativeCoding
